messages:
zoe: heads-up — enterprise customer AcroHealth reporting the analytics console goes blank when they apply Region + Model + Version filters. Charts say \"No data\" but we can see requests in the raw event log. ticket#2371 and screenshot attached.
henry: thanks zoe. can you paste the console permalink + an example request_id? also browser + timeframe they used?
zoe: permalink: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/acrohealth/analytics?range=24h&filters=%5B%7B%22k%22%3A%22region%22%2C%22v%22%3A%5B%22eu-west-1%22%5D%7D%2C%7B%22k%22%3A%22model%22%2C%22v%22%3A%5B%22redwood-v1%22%5D%7D%2C%7B%22k%22%3A%22version%22%2C%22v%22%3A%5B%22v2%22%5D%7D%5D
request_id: req_0a9c3f4b
browser: Chrome 111 on macOS. timeframe: last 24h. note: clearing the model filter makes the charts instantly repopulate.
oliver: can you write short repro steps and a curl showing what the metrics endpoint returns? need to know if backend is returning empty series or if frontend is dropping them.
zoe: repro steps I gave the customer: 1) open analytics 24h 2) select Region -> eu-west-1 3) select Model -> redwood-v1 4) select Version -> v2 -> charts blank.
Curl that returned datapoints for me:
```
curl -s "https://api.redwood.ai/metrics?org=acrohealth&start=1688000000&end=1688086400&region=eu-west-1&model=redwood-v1&version=v2" -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" | jq .data[:3]
# returned several time buckets with counts > 0
```
so backend has data. customer sees UI empty.
devops-bot: frontend-deploy v2.14.7 rolled at 2026-03-15T12:22:11Z to prod (release: feature/filter-multiselect).
emily: I can reproduce locally — looks specific to how the UI encodes multi-select when you ctrl/cmd-click multiple versions. The selection payload sometimes serializes versions as an empty array. example payload from network tab: `{"filters":{"region":["eu-west-1"],"model":["redwood-v1"],"version":[]}}` -> backend returns data but frontend treats empty array as explicit filter -> results in no series displayed. :eyes:
emily: attaching quick stack snippet, the normalizer function at src/ui/filters/normalize.js is stripping version values when selection state toggles rapidly.
raj: thanks for the reproduce and trace. that normalize change landed in PR #987 last week. looks like a race when selection toggles (multi-click) — versions can be dropped. i'll put up an emergency patch to treat [] as "no-op" (i.e., ignore empty lists rather than applying them). rolling to staging now.
zoe: awesome. can we also give customer a workaround in the interim? they'd like anything we can tell them to keep dashboards working.
raj: workaround: ask them to use single-click (avoid ctrl/cmd multi-select) or clear and re-add filters. alternative: query the metrics API directly — sample: `GET /metrics?org=acrohealth&region=eu-west-1&model=redwood-v1` (omit version). we'll send a quick note to the account. planning patch to prod in ~45m. :+1:
zoe: will update ticket and ping AcroHealth. please post here when prod patch is live so I can close the loop. thanks all!
